title: KestrelCare Coverage Level Credits Against Trade-In Shortfalls
content:
A buyer who protects the new purchase under **KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts** earns a protection credit against a **Trade-In Agreements** payoff shortfall payment. The contract read is the one written on the purchase the trade is applied to.

| KestrelCare service contract written on the purchase | Protection credit |
|---|---|
| KestrelCare Gold | $50.00 |
| KestrelCare Platinum | $50.00 |
| KestrelCare Platinum Exclusionary | $50.00 |
| KestrelCare Powertrain | $25.00 |
| KestrelCare Powertrain Plus | $25.00 |
| KestrelCare Silver | $25.00 |
| No contract | None |

The protection credit is subtracted in figuring the shortfall payment; the payment never falls below none and is rounded to the nearest cent only once, at the end.

## Points of reading

- The contract counted is the one written on the purchase order the trade is applied to, not a contract on the traded vehicle.
- The upper credit of $50.00 goes with the Gold, Platinum and Platinum Exclusionary levels; the basic credit of $25.00 with the Powertrain, Powertrain Plus and Silver levels.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A shortfall figured at $812.40 before credits, on a trade applied to a purchase carrying KestrelCare Silver, becomes $787.40.
